'''Modelica: Acausal DAE Domain Survey'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''Modelica''' is an acausal, object-oriented equation-based language engineered to compile and solve Differential-Algebraic Equations (DAEs) with respect to time <math>t</math>.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Lumped Classical Mechanics (8.0/10):''' Native gold standard for multi-body mechanical kinematics and continuous time-dependent DAE integration.
* '''Field Theory & Relativity Limitations (2.0/10):''' Unsuited for continuous spatial PDEs, tensor algebra, or quantum operator manifolds without prior spatial discretization.
